quantisation: fp8_e4m3_w8a8_dynamic(per-output-channel weight scales, per-token activation scales; lm_head/embeddings/norms bf16)
uniform_key: u_stream(task, template, k) = PCG64(stable_seed(task, template, k)), identical in every arm
batch_layout: every batch has 20 rows of one (task, template): one 20-slot block or two 10-slot blocks; prune=False

decision_rules.C2d: Per task: avoidance per arm with Wilson CIs; CRN flip tables for ADD vs each RAND at the same alpha; a one-sided exact McNemar test (H1: ADD avoidance > RAND avoidance), Holm over 3 controls x 2 alphas. A task PASSES ADD if, at some alpha in {1, 2}, all three Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND ADD's modal non-default label (requiring >= 10 non-default attempts) equals the named ban's modal non-banned label. Denominator = tasks where the named ban passes the EVENT GATE (avoidance >= 0.5 AND >= 20 non-banned attempts). On gate-failing tasks only the avoidance contrast is reported. SUBTRACT: for each task, Delta = banned share(SUB_plain) - banned share(ban, same slots), with a paired bootstrap CI over slots. Pooled Delta = the mean over the GATED tasks (those where the named ban's banned share is <= 0.5), with a task-level bootstrap and jackknife. C2d SUPPORTED iff ADD passes on >= 2/3 of the denominator tasks AND pooled Delta >= 0.3 with the CI lower bound > 0. DISCONFIRMED iff ADD avoidance is within the random range (not above max RAND) on > 1/3 of the tasks. Otherwise PARTIAL. Necessity is credited to v only if SUB_plain or SUB_affine exceeds SUB_rand by >= 0.15.
decision_rules.C2e: Classes: 1 = default mechanism (incl. renamed/disguised defaults), 0 = any other attempted label incl. 'other'; 'invalid' and 'disputed' excluded. Eligible tasks have >= 8 of each class in the named-ban samples (T1 primary includes the declared W4 top-up: 100 + 60). Per position in {R, S-mean, 1..8, 16} and block 8..28: L2 logistic (batched IRLS; C by inner 3-fold CV from {1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1}) on standardised states after PCA-64 fit on the training fold; 5-fold stratified by (template, class); pooled balanced accuracy; null = 500 within-template label permutations with full refits and a layer-max statistic per position. Text controls at each k (all with template one-hot): Ta one-hot token ids at 1..k; Tb layer-0 embeddings (mean of 1..k concatenated with token k), PCA-64; Tc exact prefix-match leave-one-out majority within template (fallback: template majority). R baseline = decoder at R (template-only by construction). LOCUS RULE (frozen): the first k in 1..8 at which max over blocks of state BA >= max(BA_R, BA_Ta, BA_Tb, BA_Tc) + 0.10 AND state BA > the layer-max null q95. 'Locus at tokens 1-3' requires k <= 3. Non-eligible tasks are 'not testable'. Conditional causal patch only if a locus (k*, L*) is found.
decision_rules.C2f: Banned share for the target head set {L21H17, L26H21, L26H25} and each of 3 layer-matched random sets (k 0-9 slots), CRN flip tables against the no-ablation ban. Delta_T1 = target - mean(random). SUPPORTED iff Delta_T1 >= 0.15 (exact paired test against each random set, p < 0.05) AND |Delta_T2| <= 0.10 (90% CI reported).
decision_rules.0g: FR_zero = (CE_zero - CE_sae) / (CE_zero - CE_clean). FROZEN PASS(L) := FR_zero(instruct, own text) >= 0.9 x FR_zero(base, own text). Companions: FR_mean, KL(clean||spliced), dCE ratio on own text, FVU and L0, displacement preservation cos(SAE(h_ban) - SAE(h_twin), h_ban - h_twin) and norm ratio at S. 5a stays descriptive whatever 0g shows (the zero-ablation denominator of ~12 nats makes the frozen rule lenient).
decision_rules.event_gate: named ban avoidance >= 0.5 AND >= 20 non-banned attempts
decision_rules.best_alpha: alpha in {1, 2} with the highest avoidance among those with pass rate >= 0.5; ties -> alpha 1

predictions.P1: ADD at alpha 1 or 2 beats every random control on >= 2/3 of the gated tasks and lands on the named ban's modal survivor.
predictions.P2: SUB raises the banned share by >= 0.3.
predictions.P3: C2e: no position beats the text controls by 0.10. State and text curves rise together at the first divergent token; the expected T2 fork is the import line, tokens 3-5.
predictions.P4: C2f: T1 banned share rises >= 0.15 over random heads, T2 is unchanged.
predictions.P5: 0g: PASS by the frozen rule, with expected FR_zero about 0.98-0.995 for both models.

deviations_declared_before_sampling: FP8 W8A8-dynamic quantisation of the pinned bf16 weights (16 GB RTX 2000 Ada; F2 named bnb-8bit only because it assumed a GPU without FP8 support)
batch of 20 rows (two 10-slot blocks) instead of 10; N=50 arms that cannot be paired in a batch get the slots k 10-19 as extra rows (N=100) rather than idle padding
